hints.title: Bitwise Carry Analysis
hints.text: The expression x or (x + 1) flips the lowest zero of x to one and retains all higher bits.

hints.title: Even Prime Edge Case
hints.text: Because the operation always produces an odd number, prime 2 has no solution and maps to -1.

hints.title: Minimal Value Formation
hints.text: For any odd number, locate the lowest bit 0 at position i. To minimize x, clear the bit at position i - 1 using xor.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Constant time bit manipulations per element, processing 10^5 elements easily.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force linear search over numbers up to 10^9 encounters severe TLE.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space excluding output array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies bitwise analysis of x OR (x + 1) to solve for x in O(1) time.
